pure-announcement.rationale: A conceptual essay, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No eval-methodology concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: A framework proposal argued from mechanism; it makes no empirical claims needing sources.

durability.rationale: The central reframing — the expected output of a non-deterministic system is an envelope of outputs acceptable to the target user, with property hierarchies chosen per audience — is conceptual and ages well.

actionability.rationale: Deliberately anti-prescriptive ("there can not be a comprehensive prescriptive guide"); it shapes thinking rather than giving a procedure.

atomicity.rationale: One thesis carried through: evals as the unit tests of GenAI.
